name: Sage

low.description: About 1 tablespoon fresh or 1 teaspoon dried

siboNotes: Fresh herbs like sage are generally well-tolerated and may have antimicrobial properties that could be beneficial for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Use fresh sage leaves whole in cooking or chop finely to release more flavor
Dried sage is more concentrated - use about 1/3 the amount compared to fresh
Add sage near the end of cooking to preserve its delicate flavor
Store fresh sage wrapped in damp paper towel in refrigerator for up to 1 week
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds
Contains vitamin K for bone health
Good source of iron and calcium
Provides rosmarinic acid with potential cognitive benefits
